paper_title: Fused Dithienogermolodithiophene Low Band Gap Polymers for High-Performance Organic Solar Cells without Processing Additives

knowledge_points.content: pDTTG-TPD is synthesized via Stille polycondensation of a novel ladder-type fused ring donor, dithienogermolodithiophene (DTTG), with N-octylthienopyrrolodione (TPD).
knowledge_points.evidence: Polymerization of this extended monomer with N . octylthienopyrrolodione by Stille polycondensation afforded a polymer, pDTTG-TPD, with an optical band gap of 1.75 eV combined with a high ionization potential.

knowledge_points.content: The synthesis of the dithienogermolodithiophene monomer utilizes a base-catalyzed rearrangement known as the halogen dance mechanism to position bromine atoms on the thieno[3,2-b]thiophene units.
knowledge_points.evidence: Here we exploit the propensity of thienylhalides to undergo base catalyzed rearrangements (the halogen dance mechanism) to afford the most stable organometallic species. Thus treatment of 5-bromothieno[3,2-b]thiophen-2-yl)-(trimethyl)silane 3 with 1 equiv of LDA at −78 °C afforded the rearranged 6-bromothieno[3,2-b]thiophen-2-yl)-(trimethyl)silane.

knowledge_points.content: Germanium was selected as the bridging atom for the DTTG donor because it offers improved stability to base compared to silicon analogs and lowers the HOMO and LUMO energy levels through interaction of the germylene σ* orbital with the π* orbital of the aromatic system.
knowledge_points.evidence: The germanium bridging group was utilized because of its improved stability to base over the analogous Si compounds... replacement of the C bridge with Si or Ge alters the electronic energy levels of the resultant polymers, generally resulting in a lowering of both the HOMO and LUMO. This has been rationalized by interaction σ* orbital of the silylene/germylene fragment with the π* orbital of the aromatic system.

knowledge_points.content: Organic solar cells based on pDTTG-TPD:PC71BM (1:2 w/w) blends achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 7.2%, with a Voc of 0.81 V, a Jsc of 13.85 mA/cm², and a fill factor (FF) of 64%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The illuminated (AM1.5) current density-voltage (J-V) curve in Figure 2 exhibits a Voc of 0.81 V, a Jsc of 13.85 mA cm−2, and a FF of 64% leading a PCE of 7.2%.

knowledge_points.content: High performance in pDTTG-TPD:PC71BM devices is achieved without processing additives like diiodooctane (DIO); the addition of DIO actually decreased device efficiency to 5.9%.
knowledge_points.evidence: Bulk heterojunction solar cells based upon pDTTG-TPDs PC71BM blends afforded efficiencies up to 7.2% without the need for thermal annealing or processing additives... the use of the high boiling additive diiodooctane (DIO) led to deterioration in device performance to 5.9%.

knowledge_points.content: pDTTG-TPD exhibits a pi-pi stacking distance of 3.6 Å, which is significantly smaller than the typical 3.7-3.8 Å distances found in other thieno[3,2-b]thiophene containing polymers like pBTTT.
knowledge_points.evidence: Both films displayed a broad diffraction peak at 24.7° (2θ) corresponding to a d spacing of 3.6 Å... This is smaller than the typical distances of 3.7-3.8 Å observed for other TT containing polymers like pBTTT.

knowledge_points.content: pDTTG-TPD demonstrates p-type charge carrier mobilities up to 0.11 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ in bottom-contact, bottom-gate organic field-effect transistors (OFETs).
knowledge_points.evidence: Nevertheless the polymer still exhibited promising p-type transistor performance, with saturated charge carrier mobilities up to 0.11 cm2 V−1 s−1 observed.

knowledge_points.content: Transient absorption spectroscopy shows that pDTTG-TPD:PC71BM blends generate charges efficiently even with a low energy offset, and the power law decay exponent of ~0.45 indicates a low level of energetic disorder.
knowledge_points.evidence: The large amplitude of the transients... suggests that charge generation is very efficient in this system, despite the relatively low-energy offset driving charge separation... The exponent of the power law decay is ~0.45 and indicative of a reasonably low level of energetic disorder.

knowledge_points.content: The open-circuit voltage (Voc) of pDTTG-TPD devices is determined by nongeminate recombination, and the 250 mV increase in Voc compared to P3HT corresponds to the measured increase in the electronic band gap.
knowledge_points.evidence: indicating that Voc is determined by nongeminate recombination... specifically a measured increase of electronic band gap by 247 mV relative to P3HT agrees quantitatively with an increase in Voc by ~250 mV.

knowledge_points.content: pDTTG-TPD exhibits high thermal stability with the onset of degradation at 340 °C and a 5% weight loss at 385 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: The thermal stability of the polymer was good, with the onset of degradation occurring at 340 °C and 5% weight loss at 385 °C.

knowledge_points.content: The electrochemical energy levels of pDTTG-TPD are a HOMO of -5.68 eV and a LUMO of -3.88 eV, resulting in an electrochemical band gap of 1.8 eV.
knowledge_points.evidence: the energy levels of the HOMO and LUMO were evaluated with the value of -5.68 and -3.88 eV... electrochemical band gap was calculated as 1.8 eV, which is in excellent agreement with that of optical band gap.
